current_case.scope: Selected upper-ocean North Atlantic continuation from40N50W toward west-of-Ireland approach. Exclude upstream Gulf Stream, Iceland/Norwegian/Canary branches, recirculation and whole Gulf Stream System.
current_case.threshold_basis: Exploratory OSW upper200m signed-component contour diagnostic,10cm/s primary for the fast North Brazil surface branch and5cm/s for the regional North Atlantic/Labrador branches. Same-node5/10/20cm/s sensitivity is retained. No author-adopted unique physical boundary, universal current definition, water-mass interface or uncertainty interval is asserted.

source_global_attributes.distribution_statement: Approved for public release. Distribution unlimited.
source_global_attributes.institution: Fleet Numerical Meteorology and Oceanography Center
